name: Demon City
source:
On the continent of Barnhedge, there lies a kingdom named Vagrand. The inhabitants of the country are followers of what they call "Vagrand's True Faith", which teaches them, quite simply, to enjoy life in all possible ways, without controlling their desires and lust. As a result, the capital of Vagrand became the center of corporeal pleasures, and its neighbors started calling it the "Demon City". The player controls a Vagrand sex warrior who is sent by the king on a confident mission. But intrigues and uncontrolled lust surround the hero everywhere: opposition in the palace, a young girl named Milk who wants him all for herself, and the mysterious cult of the Blue Moon are all there to make the hero's life hard...

[Edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/demon-city]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
巴恩赫奇大陆上坐落着一个名为瓦格兰德的王国。这里的居民信奉所谓的“瓦格兰德真教”，其教义十分简单：用一切可能的方式享受人生，绝不压抑自身的欲望与情欲。因此，瓦格兰德王都成了肉体欢愉的中心，邻国也开始称它为“恶魔之城”。玩家将扮演一名瓦格兰德性爱战士，奉国王之命执行机密任务。然而，阴谋与失控的情欲无处不在：宫廷里的反对势力、想要独占他的少女米尔克，以及神秘的蓝月教团，都让主角的日子变得困难重重……

[编译自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/demon-city]Moby Games[/url]]
